fomod.Name: AllTogether SKSE (Skyrim Together Add-ons Bundle)

fomod.Description: Ragdoll/Physics, LipSync, RaceMenu and SkyParkour Together with one Skyrim Together launcher for STR 1.8.3, 1.8.4, 1.8.5 and 1.8.7-4 on Skyrim 1.7.104, 1.6.1170/1.6.1179 and 1.5.97, and an optional server that relays add-on messages. See the installed Docs for setup.
